title: USCIS change of address
facts: Most non-U.S. citizens in the United States must report a change of address to USCIS within 10 days of moving.
Changing an address with the U.S. Postal Service does not update the address with USCIS.
USCIS recommends using the online change-of-address process when available; changing the address for a pending case helps ensure notices go to the correct address.
Some categories are subject to different procedures or exceptions.
